summary: The CLI delivery is solid, tested and drift-free, but one checkpoint error path mutates state while reporting refusal (blocking), and the writer surface shows smaller demonstrated defects: malformed-argument tracebacks, an uncaught lock refusal in rebind, ended pending runs left writable, a false decision-ordering refusal, the digest still reporting summed parallel durations, two documented validation rules not enforced, and a lock window that does not cover the read-modify-write it guards.

findings.summary: checkpoint validates declared files only after the state write, so a refusal still advances the stage, appends history and clears relay while exiting 1 as a refusal.
findings.evidence: cmd_checkpoint calls write_run at line 532 and only at lines 539-541 checks declared files exist. Reproduced: `checkpoint plan --files nope/missing.txt` exits 1 yet moves stage review->tasks and history 4->5, leaving the worktree dirty and uncommitted. Breaks the 'a refused write changes nothing' contract asserted in tests.test_commands.WriterTests.test_checkpoint_refuses_invalid_state_untouched; ENG-17. declared_from_envelope's die at lines 471-477 has the same after-write ordering.
findings.fix: Resolve the declared list (including --envelope) and check every declared path exists before write_run; only then mutate state and commit.

findings.summary: ledger-add with a malformed --started-at/--ended-at crashes with a TypeError traceback and exit 1 instead of a usage error (exit 5).
findings.evidence: Reproduced: `ledger-add plan role --started-at not-a-date` dies with TypeError (state.parse_iso returns None, line 578 subtracts it). contracts/cli.md reserves 5 for invalid argument values; ENG-17.
findings.fix: Parse the flags via state.parse_iso in cli.py and die_usage on None before calling cmd_ledger_add.

findings.summary: cmd_rebind calls state.write_state directly, so a live-lock refusal escapes as an uncaught LockHeld traceback.
findings.evidence: Reproduced under a live foreign lock: Traceback ... lock.LockHeld. Other writers route through write_run (lines 406-412) which converts LockHeld to CLIError; cli.main catches only StateError/CLIError. ENG-17; contracts/cli.md.
findings.fix: Route cmd_rebind's write through write_run (or catch lock.LockHeld in cli.main).

findings.summary: resolve_target's pending branch omits the ended-run filter, so pr-open/aborted pending runs remain writable.
findings.evidence: Docstring line 374 says 'Ended runs are never writable'; worktree loop skips pr-open/aborted (line 381), pending comprehension (392-398) does not. Reproduced: ledger-add against an aborted pending run returns rc=0. ENG-15, ENG-17.
findings.fix: Apply the same status skip to the pending branch of resolve_target.

findings.summary: checkpoint migrates relay answers keeping their original timestamps, so a legitimate flow is falsely refused when a later-dated decision already exists.
findings.evidence: settled_answers preserves answer.at and appends at the end of decisions, while state._check_decisions refuses decreasing times. Reproduced: decision at 09:00 plus relay answer from the previous day makes `checkpoint grill` fail with 'decisions go backwards in time'. ENG-26.
findings.fix: Stamp migrated answers with the checkpoint's own now, or insert them in at order.

findings.summary: show's digest still reports agent and human time as naive sums beside the union-based totals.
findings.evidence: digest computes spawns.agent_ms = sum(duration_ms) and waits.human_ms = sum(latency_ms) (lines 127-141) while state.md Totals says 'No report sums parallel durations' and FR-009 mandates unions. ENG-6.
findings.fix: Report the unions under waits/spawns too, or drop the summed fields and keep only counts.

findings.summary: Two relay rules from data-model.md are not enforced: exactly one open relay round, and answer-key checking is skipped when a round has no parseable question ids.
findings.evidence: data-model.md rule 5; _check_relay/_check_round (297-329) check neither open-round uniqueness nor answers when ids is empty. SC-001/SC-005; ENG-3/ENG-16.
findings.fix: Count open rounds and report when != 1; flag answer keys whenever the round's question ids are absent.

findings.summary: The lock is acquired by check-then-write with no atomicity and only around the file replace, so concurrent writers interleave instead of being refused.
findings.evidence: lock.acquire read() then _write() (89-105); callers read state in resolve_target long before write_state takes the lock (state.py 371-393). Last writer wins silently. ENG-23, ENG-26, FR-005.
findings.fix: Create the lock with O_CREAT|O_EXCL and acquire it before reading the state in write commands, releasing after the write.

findings.summary: The installer's effective-model report reads personal config only when FACTORY_HOME is exported, and when it is, the re-render bakes personal models into the committed dist/.
findings.evidence: install.sh runs `python3 tools/render.py "$1" --models`; render.py merges ${FACTORY_HOME}/config.json only when FACTORY_HOME is set. Users with ~/.factory/config.json see shipped defaults (FR-015); with FACTORY_HOME exported dist/ gets personal model ids, breaking constitution III and CI's drift gate.
findings.fix: Report effective models without writing dist/ (e.g. render.py --report reading the default factory home), and never re-render into the checkout at install time.

findings.summary: replay.py re-implements parse_iso and copies the closed vocabularies instead of importing them from factory_cli.state.
findings.evidence: Lines 18-43 duplicate HISTORY_EVENTS/TIMELINE_KINDS and parse_iso. ENG-6; SC-002.

findings.summary: Three test modules define test classes after the `if __name__ == '__main__'` block, so direct execution runs only part of each suite.
findings.evidence: test_commands.py (from line 255), test_lock.py (from 158), test_render_models.py (from 172). Discovery unaffected. ENG-7.
findings.fix: Move the trailing classes above the main guard or drop the per-file main blocks.

findings.summary: Every behaviour task is delivered as a separate failing-tests commit plus an implementation commit, the separate red commit ENG-3 forbids, with no Overridden line recorded in the plan.
findings.fix: Record `Overridden: ENG-3 - <the plan's paired red/implement task structure>` in plan.md.
